v1.4.2g (16 November 2022) |feed_title = Wox's Pizza Party! |previous_update = [[v1.4.0|Wanted Dead Update]] |next_update = [[v1.5.0]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''v1.4.2''' is the forty-fourth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 31st of October 2022. This update is notable for adding [[Pizza Party]] to the game. Oddly, the update version for this update is ''v1.4.2'', despite there being no ''v1.4.1'' update. This update was also given the name '''Halloween 2022 Update'''. This version encompassed eight updates, the main v1.4.2 update (released 31 October 2022) and seven minor updates, the v1.4.2a (released the same day as v1.4.0, 31 October 2022), v1.4.2b (released 1 November 2022), v1.4.2c (released 2 November 2022), v1.4.2d (released 11 November 2022), v1.4.2e (released 11 November 2022), v1.4.2f (released 15 November 2022) and v1.4.2g (released 16 November 2022) updates. ==Additions== ===Towers=== *[[Warden]] ===Enemies=== *[[Scout (Pizza Party)|Scout]] *[[Monkey]] *[[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunner]] *[[Balloon Kid]] *[[Commander (Pizza Party)|Commander]] *[[Mimic Umbra]] *[[Minigunner (Pizza Party)|Minigunner]] *[[Wox the Fox]] ===Maps=== *[[Pizza Party]] (Special) *[[Mason Arch]] (Survival & Special) *[[Forgetten Docks]] (Survival) *[[Necropolis]] (Survival & Hardcore) ===Miscellaneous=== *[[Warden]] [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] *[[Pizza Party (Modifier)|Pizza Party]] modifier *[[Lost Souls]] modifier *[[Blood]] modifier *[[Halloween]] modifier *[[Pizza Party]] matchmaking statues **One can be found near the [[Elevators#Special Elevators|Special Elevators]], while the second is in the middle of the lobby *[[Badges|Defeated Wox the Fox!]] and [[Badges|The Lost Souls!]] badges **[[Badges|Defeated Wox the Fox!]] allows you to purchase the [[Warden]] **[[Badges|The Lost Souls!]] badge gives the {{Color|Other|Slaughter}} [[Warden]] skin *Autumn lobby **[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DfVU8YpMLV0 Solar Eclipse Lobby] music plays, rarely [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rTdBvGlf4BE Spooky!] plays instead :In '''v1.4.2g''': *New [[Codes|code]] obtained by purchasing a [[DJ Booth Plush]] **Code is unique for each [[DJ Booth Plush]] bought **Gives {{Color|Other|Plushie}} [[DJ Booth]] skin ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Golden Cowboy]] nerfed. **'''Level 2''' ***Cost increased from {{Money|400}} to {{Money|450}}. **'''Level 3''' ***Cost increased from {{Money|2,150}} to {{Money|2,250}}. *New {{Color|Golden}} [[Soldier]] skin idle and firing animations. *[[Engineer]] gamepass now re-sold for {{Robux|4,000}}. *[[Pyromancer]] and [[Golden Pyromancer]] speed up removed. *[[Autumn Falling]] changed. **Map remade. **Now has the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier active. *[[Marshlands]] changed. **Map remade. **Made playable in Hardcore mode. **Difficulty changed from {{Color|Normal}} to {{Color|Easy}}. **Now has the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier active. *[[Harbor]] changed. **Map remade. **Made playable in Hardcore mode. **Now has the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier active. *[[Fungi Island]] changed. **Map remade. **Made playable in Hardcore mode. **Now has the [[Enemies Beta]] modifier active. *[[Badlands II]] and [[Polluted Wasteland II]] no longer have dialogue. *[[Halloween]] modifier is now active in all matches to celebrate Halloween. *[[Breaker2]], [[Breaker3]] and [[Breaker4]] death sounds changed. *[[Enemies Beta]] changed. **Now changes the appearance of the [[Normal]], [[Speedy]], [[Slow]], [[Normal Boss]], [[Hidden]], [[Slow Boss]], [[Hidden Boss]] and [[Speedy Boss]]. **Now increases the health of the [[Quick]] from 4 to 6. **Now changes wave layout: ***The [[Breaker2]] replaces the [[Mystery]]. ****The [[Breaker2]] also spawns the [[Breaker]] upon death. ***The [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] replaces the [[Dark Necromancer]]. ****The [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] also spawns [[Skeleton]]s with its ''Summon'' ability. ***The [[Breaker4]] replaces the [[Mystery Boss]]. ****The [[Breaker4]] also spawns [[Breaker3]]s upon death. ***The [[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]] replaces the [[Templar]]. ***The [[Necromancer King|Necromancer Boss]] replaces the [[Summoner Boss]]. ****The [[Necromancer King|Necromancer Boss]] also spawns [[Cursed Skeleton]]s with its ''Cursed Summon'' ability. ***[[Nuclear]] and [[Badlands (Modifier)|Badlands]] modifiers no longer change these enemies. **Now increases health of the [[Quick]] from 4 to 6. *[[Mutation]] modifier's health increase percentage now depends on map. **Shield health is increased by 5% in [[Badlands II]]. **Shield health is increased by 8% in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. **Shield health is increased by 10% in [[Pizza Party]]. *[[All Paths]] modifier description changed. *Fixed the [[Engineer]] not having lead detection at Level 0+. *Fixed the [[Sledger]] not having lead detection at Level 2+. *Fixed [[All Paths]] modifier not increasing rewards. *Fixed [[Boss]] health bars. A [[Boss]] enemy's health bar will no longer appear lower than it should, due to already killed [[Boss]]es that spawned before it. *Fixed final wave music not playing in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. :In '''v1.4.2a''': *Increased [[Wox the Fox]]'s health from 250,000 to 450,000. :In '''v1.4.2b''': *Decreased [[Wox the Fox]]'s health from 450,000 to 250,000. *[[Halloween]] modifier is no longer active in all matches. :In '''v1.4.2c''': *Fixed the [[Necromancer King|Necromancer Boss]], [[Skeleton]], [[Cursed Skeleton]], [[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]] and [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] having incorrect health in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. :In '''v1.4.2d''': *Lobby updated to include a Shavetopia area. *Extended [[Philips x TDS Season]] to 9 ranks, ranks 5-9 can now also be unlocked. **Rewards: ***Rank 5 - Dallas Mustache ***Rank 6 - {{Color|Philips|Baseball}} [[Warden]] ***Rank 7 - {{Color|Philips|Mage}} [[Pyromancer]] & [[Golden Pyromancer]] ***Rank 8 - {{Color|Philips|Crypto}} [[Farm]] ***Rank 9 - {{Color|Philips|Mechanic}} [[Engineer]] :In '''v1.4.2e''': *Decreased Razors required in the [[Philips x TDS Season]] for ranks. **Rank 5 amount of Razors required decreased from 1,400 to 1,000. **Rank 6 amount of Razors required decreased from 1,800 to 1,250. **Rank 7 amount of Razors required decreased from 2,600 to 1,600. **Rank 8 amount of Razors required decreased from 3,300 to 2,200. **Rank 9 amount of Razors required decreased from 4,000 to 3,000. :In '''v1.4.2f''': *Fixed Razor limit being 4,000 instead of 3,000. :In '''v1.4.2g''': *{{Color|Other|Plushie}} [[Commander]] code is now obtainable by purchasing the Level 4 version of [[Commander Plush (Level 4)|Commander Plush]]. **Code is unique for each [[Commander Plush (Level 4)|Commander Plush]] bought. *Updated lobby. *Partially fixed idle animations of towers.
